name: Grocy
category: self-hosted server (household ERP: stock, recipes, meal plan, chores)
param_style: LessQL (berrnd fork): WHERE fragments with values inlined as quoted strings, or :1 binds as PDO strings; raw PDO for services; backtick identifiers
schema_source: migrations/0001.sql..0257.sql replayed in order with the sqlite3 CLI (PHP migrations skipped), dumped with .schema; verbatim except grocy_user_setting('stock_due_soon_days') (a PHP UDF) replaced by its default 5
data_scale: scale 1: 600 products (40 parents), 30 QUs, ~450 QU conversions (9.4k cached resolved), 34.9k stock_log rows over 5 years skewed to 80 staples, ~1k stock entries, 80 normal recipes (3 nesting levels, ~13 ingredients) plus the ~190 day/week/shadow recipes the meal-plan trigger builds for 60 days of plan (~150 entries), 9k chores_log over 4 years, 900 battery cycles. Scale multiplies products, stock_log and chores_log; the recipe set stays fixed because the SQLite 3.53 recipes plan grows roughly with recipes^2 x positions (scale 1 already reproduces the issue's 6-15 s)
visibility_note: 9.6k stars; SQLite is the only backend; widely self-hosted (linuxserver/grocy image)
interest_note: View-on-view logic: recursive CTEs (recipe nestings, transitive unit conversions with window FIRST_VALUE), UNIONs of GROUP BYs with correlated sums, bare-column aggregates, triggers that re-evaluate recursive views per insert; the SQLite 3.53 UNION sort-and-merge change makes recipes_pos_resolved ~45x slower than UNION ALL on this data.

cpu_evidence.summary: SQLite 3.53 UNION sort-and-merge: recipes_pos_resolved 6.4 s and recipes_resolved 15.7 s (vs 0.16/0.32 s on 3.45); /recipes and /mealplan 10-15 s; ~2k resolved positions
Same view: UNION -> UNION ALL takes recipes_pos_resolved 6.4 s -> 0.13 s and recipes_resolved 15.7 s -> 0.3 s on 3.53.4

Meal plan insert timing out: prevent_infinite_nested_recipes trigger evaluates recipes_nestings_resolved (0.9 s, 234 recipes / 3.9k nestings) when the CTE is materialised; uihelper_stock_current_overview >60 s on 3.46.1 with 917 products
/stock/products/{id} up to 10x slower in v4.0.0 because of products_current_price / products_last_purchased
SQLite 3.54.1: creating any product fails with 'VIEWs and/or subqueries nested too deep' (closed without a reproduction)
Duplicate of #3008, same error on product creation with SQLite 3.54.1

sqlite_compat: SQLite 3.54.1 breaks Grocy: its new nested-CTE guard (sqlite3.c 'Bug 2026-10-04T05:35:14Z', pParse->nTab checked against SQLITE_LIMIT_EXPR_DEPTH=1000) counts cursors across the whole trigger program of INSERT INTO products, which expands the recursive quantity_unit_conversions_resolved view in about a dozen triggers. Any product insert fails with 'VIEWs and/or subqueries nested too deep' (needs a limit of about 1,790); reads of every corpus view still work at 1000. data.sql drops the two qu_id_stock cascade triggers during the load (they never fire there) so the corpus builds on 3.54.1; the app itself can't add products.
